title: CSS Variables Practice
prompt: Create Sass variables for brand colors, font size, spacing, and border radius, then use them in two components.

public_tests.name: Expected behavior
public_tests.note: This starter grader checks required terms only; compile and inspect the real CSS before considering the work correct.

acceptance_criteria: Implements the requested Sass pattern for css variables practice.
Includes a repeatable command or source-to-output check.
Documents one edge case, assumption, accessibility concern, or maintenance trade-off.
hints: Start with tokens that describe roles, not appearance alone.
Compile a minimal source file with `npx sass input.scss output.css` and inspect the generated CSS.
Compare the source and expected output; refine the pattern before adding more components.

retry_policy.guidance: Use the feedback to improve the source and resubmit; the platform controls activity completion and its standard reward policy.

expected_output: At least four meaningful variables reused by two styles. Inspect whether the chosen values belong at compile time or should be CSS custom properties.
status_note: Draft exercise. The automatic grader is a lightweight submission gate; technical correctness requires compilation and/or human review.
